title: fix(next-app-router): better detection of route change
body:
**Summary**

This is a follow-up to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6452 which provides a better way to handle more use cases, adding one where route changes to a non-InstantSearch implementation, and navigates back to it.

**Result**

Search is performed properly when a user navigates back to an InstantSearch implementation.
